description: This file defines command argument formatting functions for various command types, including normalization of argument values, specific formatting logic for different command categories, and exporting a record of formatters.

methods.name: normalizeArgValue
methods.description: Normalizes various types of input values into trimmed string or undefined.

methods.name: formatActionArgs
methods.description: Formats command action arguments based on provided formatting rules.

methods.name: formatSetUnsetArgAction
methods.description: Formats 'set' and 'unset' actions with optional path and value.
